name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: 可视化反向代理 + 免费 SSL 证书管理面板,统一入口网关
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${HTTP_PORT}:80"
      - "${HTTPS_PORT}:443"
      - "${ADMIN_PORT}:81"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/data:/data
      - ${DATA_PATH}/letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

name: Uptime Kuma
description: 自托管监控面板,支持 HTTP/Ping/TCP 探测与多通道通知
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3001"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/app/data

name: Ollama
description: 本地一键运行 Llama/Qwen 等大模型,OpenAI 兼容 API
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:11434"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/root/.ollama

name: Vaultwarden
description: Bitwarden 兼容的轻量密码管理器服务端
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/data
    environment:
      - DOMAIN=${DOMAIN}

name: Alist
description: 聚合网盘/对象存储的目录列表与直链工具
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: xhofe/alist:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5244"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/opt/alist/data

name: Meilisearch
description: 极速全文搜索引擎,毫秒级体验与即开即用 API
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.10
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:7700"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/meili_data
    environment:
      - MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MASTER_KEY}
      - MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=true

name: Dufs
description: 即开即用的静态文件服务,支持上传下载与 WebDAV
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: sigoden/dufs:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5000"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/data
    command: ["/data"]

name: RustDesk Server
description: 开源远程桌面中继服务器,替代 TeamViewer
defaultCompose:
services:
  hbbs:
    image: rustdesk/rustdesk-server:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-hbbs
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${RELAY_PORT}:21115"
      - "21116:21116"
    command: hbbs -r ${HOST}:${RELAY_PORT}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/root
  hbbr:
    image: rustdesk/rustdesk-server:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-hbbr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${RELAY_PORT}:21117"
    command: hbbr
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/root

name: MinIO
description: S3 兼容对象存储,单机部署高性能文件存储
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${API_PORT}:9000"
      - "${CONSOLE_PORT}:9001"
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      - MINIO_ROOT_USER=${MINIO_USER}
      - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MINIO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/data

name: Grafana + Prometheus
description: 经典可观测性组合:指标采集 + 可视化大盘
defaultCompose:
services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PROM_PORT}:9090"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/prometheus:/etc/prometheus
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${GRAFANA_PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/grafana:/var/lib/grafana

name: IT-Tools
description: 开发者瑞士军刀:编码、格式化、加密、网络工具集
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: corentinth/it-tools:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"

name: Whoogle Search
description: 无广告、无追踪的 Google 搜索代理
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: benbusby/whoogle-search:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5000"

name: n8n
description: 可视化工作流自动化平台,连接 400+ 服务
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_BASIC_AUTH_ACTIVE=true
      - N8N_BASIC_AUTH_USER=${USERNAME}
      - N8N_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD=${PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/home/node/.n8n

name: Gitea
description: 轻量自托管 Git 服务,兼容 GitHub 工作流
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3000"
      - "${SSH_PORT}:22"
    environment:
      - GITEA__server__ROOT_URL=${DOMAIN}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}:/data

name: Homepage
description: 极简美观的自托管导航首页,聚合服务书签与状态
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/config:/app/config
      - ${DATA_PATH}/icons:/app/public/icons

name: AdGuard Home
description: 全网 DNS 广告拦截与隐私保护,局域网级过滤
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${DNS_PORT}:53/tcp"
      - "${DNS_PORT}:53/udp"
      - "${WEB_PORT}:80"
      - "${SETUP_PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ${DATA_PATH}/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf

name: Calibre-Web
description: 电子书管理与在线阅读服务器,支持 OPDS
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/calibre-web:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8083"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH}/books:/books
      - ${DATA_PATH}/config:/config
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Asia/Shanghai
